## Capability and purpose

Describe the capability affected and the concrete behavior changed.

## Verification

List checks actually run, their results, and any steps not executed. Distinguish deterministic fixtures, runtime integration, live inference and target-device verification.

## Scope and publication

- [ ] Changes remain within selected public synthetic content.
- [ ] No credentials, private identifiers, runtime state or internal logs are included.
- [ ] Third-party source and license requirements were reviewed.
- [ ] Documentation accurately states current behavior and limitations.

## Remaining work

Identify unresolved failures, integration gaps and dependencies. Do not mark a lab complete based only on static checks.
